read_status: All 182 matching post bodies were read in full. Judgments below summarize attribution and evidence value only; full post text is retained in the source result file. Contact details and author identities are intentionally not copied.
method: A same-title hit was accepted as target evidence only if the body tied it to the official ICES code/instructor/target offering. The formal roster shows only 顾慧洁 for ICLE20023 in 2025秋. Posts naming different instructors or Economics faculty/course lists were excluded. Generic title-only posts remain ambiguous; 2026秋 and summer chatter is outside scope.

finding.conclusion: No hit in this exact-title set can be attributed to the ICES 2025秋 section taught by 顾慧洁. The query is heavily contaminated by same-title Economics-department offerings, especially classes naming 石磊, 陈钊, 张晏, 王永钦, 刘志阔, 罗长远, 吴建锋, and others. No useful ICES review floor/hole ID found.
